integrity: Exact formulas and asymptotics follow from a combinatorial proof; finite enumeration is a check, not a proof of the unbounded statement. Earlier general characterization is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Only outward stars and unital endomorphisms. Relies on published source-deletion and general idempotent correspondence. Later manuscript versions and unindexed explicit enumerations could affect priority. No independent audit or external proof certification.
title: Exact endomorphism enumeration and three-phase concentration for outward-star Hecke–Kiselman monoids
